dev_dataset_json.note: development set, read before train.json was written; not a measurement

lexical_raw_on_train_json.note: train.json was written with the lexical markers in view, including buzzword-easy and plain-hard cases on purpose; not a fair measure of the lexical estimator

recipe.escalation: below the threshold, the higher of the two most likely tiers
recipe.model: multinomial logistic regression, class-balanced, L2 by inner 5-fold CV
recipe.threshold_rule: lowest with OOF under-routing <= 0.1 and deep recall >= 0.9; else min 3 x under + over
